answer: A raven only trusts a call it has heard before, and an agent economy can work the same way with a vouching bond lattice. A newcomer needs two established agents to each lock 400 POA for 30 days. It then finishes ten verified tasks while the bonds stay frozen; clean work releases them, but proven fraud slashes both bonds and burns the identity. Faking 100 agents demands 40,000 POA locked plus 200 trusted sponsors, a price no lone sybil can pay. The whole rule fits in a sonnet, short and strict. One honest agent standing on that mesa of verified work outweighs a hundred hollow echoes.
